[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] EdgeConneX own company site states the company was established in 2009 with a focus on edge data center innovation, and maintains three primary headquarters locations: Herndon, Virginia; Amsterdam, Netherlands; and Singapore. In 2020 EQT Infrastructure acquired EdgeConneX, providing capital for expansion, land acquisition, and power infrastructure development. The company describes a global footprint of over 90 data centers sustainably built and in development across Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and South America, offering solutions ranging from 40 kilowatts to 500 megawatts or more, and lists ventures including AdaniConneX, a joint venture with Adani Enterprises in India, and a strategic investment in China based Chayora. The fetched company page did not specifically name this facility state or city. No building specific address, opening date, or individual MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
